# AI Brain

> AI Brain is an early-stage Indian startup building a persistent, associative memory layer for LLMs and autonomous AI agents. The product is in development; an early-access waitlist is open.

## AI Brain vs Vector DBs
- **Flat Vector DBs:** Store isolated text chunks and retrieve approximate top-k neighbors via single-hop cosine similarity, losing causal links and multi-session decisions.
- **AI Brain (In Development):** Planned dual-layer associative hypergraph memory pairing dense vector embeddings with typed relational edges, temporal decay protection, and multi-hop recall for autonomous agent swarms (<15ms recall and ~91% redundant-token reduction design targets, not yet published benchmarks).
